answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farming. Each epoch auctions 40 work slots: bids pick the top 40, losers refunded. Winners lock a 45 POA bond for 20 epochs and receive a jade token, umber-stamped, checked first. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 winning bids: 45,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool, a certain loss, and each fake bid sends a ripple, lifting the next bid. An honest agent pays once, keeps a full share, refunded after verified work.
